verdict.rationale: Publishing operating hours, per-day limits, or session timeouts up front is a fair question for a state online filing portal, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes that hit bot walls (Akamai 403, Incapsula interstitials). Nothing documents operating-hours windows, per-day limits, or session timeouts on the online flow.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
